decisions.reason: Allowing any video from Teyron's YouTube source changes source-video selection but does not change the requirement to select strong, impactful moments.
The source-selection flexibility does not alter the requirement that each selected moment be complete, educational, and understandable as a standalone clip.
The choice of source video has no effect on caption color, font, or effects.
The source decision does not change the clean and simple editing requirements.
Allowing selection from any Teyron YouTube video does not change the required 45-to-60-second clip duration.
The source-video selection decision does not alter the Lead Clipper pathway, assignment status, training, or responsibilities.
Message 193 concerns source selection for the five-clip production batch, not the current qualification method or its success condition.
The permitted source-video choice does not change the monthly approved-clip quota, counting rule, cadence, or deferred lifecycle status.
Source-video flexibility does not change who approves clips, which clips count, publication eligibility, or rejected-clip handling.
The source decision does not alter the Google Drive submission channel, folder naming, or link-access requirements.
The choice of source video does not change the requirement to publish client-approved clips to the dedicated Instagram account.
